name: smoke-test
documentation: Calls every flow-patterns example and reports, for the platform version that ran it, which capabilities work.

input.title: SmokeRequest
input.documentation: run: a free label for this run, repeated in the report. Every check runs whatever it says.

steps.name: read the platform version
steps.note: The version comes from the process that runs the test, not from a page about the stand: the host's file version, as on the API's Swagger page, and the engine's assembly version.

steps.name: 01 input
steps.expression: return "{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"language\":\"en\"}";
steps.note: Every example is called as it is in this repository, with its own example input, through a Call Activity to the Flow of the same name in the tenant library.

steps.name: 01 check
steps.note: A check reads the answer: the failure branch's ErrorResponse, no answer or an answer without the expected marker is a failed check. Each line of the report says which.

steps.name: 02a input
steps.expression: return "{\"orderId\":\"ORD-1001\"}";

steps.name: 02a check
02b input
steps.expression: return "{\"orderId\":\"\"}";

steps.name: 02b check
03a input
steps.expression: return "{}";

steps.name: 03a check
03b input
steps.expression: return "{\"key\":\"EUR\"}";

steps.name: 03b check
04 input
steps.expression: return "{\"total\":25}";

steps.name: 04 check
05 input
steps.expression: return "{\"jobId\":\"JOB-7\"}";

steps.name: 05 check
06 input
steps.expression: return "{\"topic\":\"USD\"}";

steps.name: 06 check
07 input
steps.expression: return "{\"event\":\"order.created\",\"payload\":\"{\\\"orderId\\\":\\\"ORD-1001\\\"}\"}";

steps.name: 07 check
08 input
steps.expression: return "{\"question\":\"What changed in the last release?\",\"tone\":\"plain\"}";

steps.name: 08 check
09 input
steps.expression: return "{\"note\":\"quarterly summary\"}";

steps.name: 09 check
verdict
steps.note: The verdict sets the HTTP status of the answer through WorkflowEnvironment.Variables[StatusCode], as the built-in setResponseStatus does: 200 when every check passed, 500 when any failed. The body is the report either way.

success.title: ALL_PASSED
success.documentation: Every check passed: HTTP 200 and the report.
